---
title: "After the day"
---
A day on open research stops before the robustness exercise of the course, in which you would vary the analysis yourself, one decision at a time, send your results to a class chart, and run the specification that you preregistered. The [one-day course on methods](../housing-one-day-methods/index.qmd) does that on the same case, and the [exercise overview](../../cases/housing/exercise.qmd) sets out Tasks 4 and 5 in full; both run in the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd#task-4-menu) and in the downloadable workspace, which you can install by following the [setup page](../../setup.qmd). The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that the day can only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| Where data, code and registrations are deposited, and how a record keeps its versions | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) |
| To version a project of your own and publish its report | [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| The replication with new data, in its own words and on its own data | The final report at [osf.io/2ug8x](https://osf.io/2ug8x/), and the de-identified data, the do-file and a dictionary at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/) |
| The design of the experiment: random assignment, names as treatments, comparisons among replies, randomisation inference, power and the ethics of deception | [Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd) |
| The causal graph of the experiment at a slower pace | [Causal graphs and conditioning](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| The ideas behind a curve of every justifiable analysis, and the arguments now being made against them | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| R from the beginning, on the same data | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| The whole story of the case, with the sources | [The case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) |

The [short session](../housing-short/index.qmd) covers the same case in two to three hours, and the [one-day course on data tools](../housing-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) takes it through R, data management and reports.
